research_question: Does losslessly lifting the same frozen BF16 DreamLite parameter and conditioning values into FP32 activation compute widen the teacher capture region and restore finite-difference descent for the plateau negative gradient?
causal_role: Separate the FP32-to-BF16 input/activation interface from deeper DreamLite latent-map geometry before any further optimizer training.

bf16-baseline.contract: Unmodified frozen parent DreamLite oracle; xT is cast from FP32 to BF16 at the sampler boundary.

fp32-lifted.contract: After completing BF16 measurements, cast the same in-memory frozen BF16-valued UNet and VAE parameters/buffers, source latents, and precomputed prompt embeddings losslessly to FP32; set oracle compute_dtype=float32; do not reload, regenerate conditioning, or restore unavailable weight precision.
fp32-lifted.text_encoder: Frozen and not executed because prompt embeddings are already fixed; its dtype is irrelevant and must not alter conditioning.
fp32-lifted.parameter_value_change: BF16 values are exactly representable in FP32; only arithmetic and activation/input quantization change.
fp32-lifted.teacher_endpoint: Regenerated within the FP32-lifted frozen map from the same exact teacher xT; losses are normalized only to the FP32-lifted plateau endpoint.

gradient_control.anchor: exact parent lr=0.001 raw step256 plateau xT
gradient_control.direction_per_condition: negative autograd gradient of condition-specific endpoint MSE at the shared plateau, unit L2 normalized
gradient_control.analytic_directional_derivative: dot(condition plateau gradient, condition unit negative-gradient direction)

decision_table.technical_fail: Repair only the violated precision conversion, replay, counter, determinism, or inventory contract and rerun in a fresh directory.
decision_table.fp32_restores_capture_and_gradient: FP32 capture reaches at least 0.001 L2 and widens by at least 10x over BF16, while the FP32 negative gradient reaches loss ratio <=0.9; preregister FP32 residual-centered normalized-gradient trust-region optimization.
decision_table.fp32_widens_capture_without_actionable_g: Input/activation quantization controls capture width, but deeper Jacobian geometry still blocks gradient descent; test an explicit residual/continuation parameterization before training.
decision_table.fp32_gradient_only: FP32 makes a local gradient actionable without a wide oracle capture region; audit nonlocal path geometry before any training claim.
decision_table.precision_lift_insufficient: Neither capture width nor gradient fidelity materially improves; reject BF16 input cast as the sole cause and redesign the DreamLite latent-state parameterization.
decision_table.bf16_reproduction_failure: The direct BF16 control does not reproduce the delivered terminal boundary; stop and audit before interpreting FP32.
